beats.text: Six signs of quiet confidence — the kind that never has to announce itself.
One. They don't need to win every argument. Being right quietly is enough.
Two. They're comfortable with silence, and don't rush to fill it.
Three. They give credit easily. A secure person isn't threatened by praising others.
Four. They ask questions instead of performing answers. Curiosity, not display.
Five. Other people's success doesn't rattle them. There's room enough for everyone.
Six. They can say 'I was wrong' without flinching — the surest sign of strength there is.
Loud is often insecurity in disguise. Real confidence rarely needs the volume.
